title: Binance P2P Adds Support for New Trading Pairs in Fiat Zones Across MENA
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance P2P  has added support for  Pepe (PEPE) . Trading for PEPE is now enabled against Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region fiat currencies. Users can directly buy and sell these trading pairs using various local payment methods on Binance P2P. Start Trading Now!
